_note: Study 67, session 265, 2026-11-09. For each first-hand agreement of study 66: what the texts the parties published say about who can END it, who can RESTRICT or SUSPEND the use, and any first refusal or exclusivity over compute. 'end' and 'use_restriction' are coded strictly from a text that names this agreement; 'inferred' marks a filed master agreement that probably governs the row but that no text links to it by name, and is never counted. Quotes are short passages, read 2026-11-09; 'sha256' is of the document as fetched directly that day. Definitions fixed in PREDICTIONS67.md before any search.

MSA-OAI.what: Master Services Agreement between CoreWeave, Inc. and OpenAI OpCo, LLC, dated 8 May 2025 (Exhibit 10.1 to CoreWeave's Form 8-K of 25 Sep 2025; portions redacted)

MSA-META.what: Master Services Agreement between CoreWeave, Inc. and Meta Platforms, Inc., dated 10 Dec 2023 (Exhibit 10.1 to CoreWeave's Form 8-K of 30 Sep 2025; portions redacted)

NBIS-6K-2025-11-12.what: Nebius Group Form 6-K of 12 Nov 2025 (agreement with Meta)

NBIS-6K-2026-03-16.what: Nebius Group Form 6-K of 16 Mar 2026 (agreement with Meta)

rows.exclusivity: API products OpenAI develops with third parties stay exclusive to Microsoft's cloud; Microsoft's right of first refusal to be OpenAI's compute provider ends
rows.quote: API products developed with third parties will be exclusive to Azure.
rows.quote2: Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI’s compute provider.

rows.end_how: if the provider repeatedly fails its availability requirements, OpenAI may end all or part of the commitment
rows.quote: In the event of the Company’s repeated failure to meet availability of service requirements, OpenAI has the right to terminate all or a portion of the committed amount

rows.inferred_note: an 'additional agreement' of May 2025; the filed master agreement of 8 May 2025 probably governs it, but no text says so
rows.quote: As of May 14, 2025, subject to the satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to $ 4.0 billion through April 2029 related to this agreement.

rows.end_how: either party for cause: an uncured material breach (notice period redacted) or insolvency; OpenAI also after a force majeure of 30 days. No right to end for convenience is in the unredacted text
rows.use_how: OpenAI must keep the provider's acceptable use policy and all laws, and may not export or divert the services against US sanctions and export law; but the provider may not end the agreement for unlawful use or use against its policy, its only remedy is indemnification
rows.state_lever: suspension only: the provider may suspend, for as long as necessary, to comply with a law enforcement order, subpoena or injunction that expressly requires it, or a legally binding demand of a regulator with oversight of the provider
rows.quote: A Party may terminate this Agreement (including each Order Form) for cause (i) upon [*] days’ written notice to the other Party of a material breach of this Agreement
rows.quote2: CoreWeave’s sole remedy with respect to such use shall be pursuant to Section 9(b) of this Agreement (Indemnification by Customer) and that CoreWeave shall not have the right to terminate this Agreement or the Order Form for such use.
rows.quote3: (a) solely as and for so long as necessary to comply with a law enforcement order, subpoena or injunction that expressly requires CoreWeave to do so, (b) solely as and for so long as necessary to comply with a legally binding demand from a regulatory agency that has oversight authority over CoreWeave or its Affiliates

rows.note: the page makes Amazon the exclusive third-party cloud distributor of an OpenAI product (distribution, not compute; not counted)

rows.end_how: either party on 90 days' notice, for any reason; Anthropic's own page says nothing of it
rows.quote: The agreements may be terminated by either party upon 90 days’ notice.

rows.end_how: either party for cause: an uncured material breach (notice period redacted) or insolvency; the provider without further notice after repeated non-payment
rows.use_how: use against the agreement or the provider's acceptable use policy is itself a breach; no export or diversion against US sanctions and export law
rows.state_lever: suspension only: the provider may limit or suspend use at its sole discretion for a judicial or other governmental demand or order, subpoena or law enforcement request that requires it (also for emergency maintenance and security)
rows.doc_link: filed with the 8-K that announced this order form
